region.Description: Region label of the node, for example a Desikan-Killiany label or STN.

atlas.Description: Atlas the region label comes from; n/a for direct channels.

node_kind.Description: What the channel represents in the connectivity analysis.

Levels.cortical: cortical region of interest extracted from a source estimate
Levels.direct: invasive channel used as recorded, for example an STN LFP
